scope: Jason authorized both prerequisite mechanics on 2026-10-30. Hold V to sneak at 45% speed; NPC sight/hearing builds awareness and full awareness turns the NPC toward the player. Travel/courier/mining/lumberjack bags apply -10% sneak and pickpocket skill while worn. Waist bag is neutral. Field coat gives +10% sneak and +5% pickpocket, retaining zero storage. Bonuses derive from current gear, never accumulated saved buffs. Coat plus noisy bag gives 100% sneak / 95% pickpocket skill and 76% success chance. Values are provisional for review.

scope: Requested by Jason on 2026-10-30 during GAME-26 preparation. E opens the optional abandoned lockbox beside the village path; A/D or arrows set the pick angle, Space applies tension, and Esc leaves. The cylinder rotates partially when off-angle; forcing a jam accumulates strain and can break a pick. Release to reposition. Three tolerances are supported; the authored box is Simple. The world pauses during the modal. This uses the interaction concept requested as a Skyrim reference, with original presentation and no copied assets.

Mira sells lockpicks for a base 5 gold; picks stack to 12. Only broken picks are consumed. Intact picks survive success and cancellation. Last-pick exhaustion exits safely. Ordinary campaign starts grant no kit. Unlocking and looting save separately; a full inventory preserves unlocked contents. Taking the reward gives one bronze charm and 25 gold exactly once and opens the visual lid. Quest-critical doors and accepted authored caches are unchanged. No locked-door campaign integration, NPC property crime or skill tree is claimed.
